fact: A law-faculty dean writing on droitnumerique.cd says the DRC has not yet developed its hard law on AI and that soft law still largely prevails; the article names no draft law, and no date is given for the statement so the published date 2024-08-23 is used.
Levellers says that as of June 2026 the DRC has no dedicated AI law, no AI Act and no AI bill before Parliament.
